Everything compiles and passes cleanly with ASan as well. Here's what was implemented:

**`ringbuf.c`** — all 7 functions declared in `ringbuf.h`:

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `rb_create` | Allocates opaque struct with a byte buffer of given capacity (0 → NULL) |
| `rb_destroy` | Frees buffer + struct; accepts NULL |
| `rb_write` | Writes up to `len` bytes, caps at free space so partial writes fit correctly |
| `rb_read` | Reads oldest-first, removing from buffer as it goes |
| `rb_peek` | Copies oldest-first without consuming data |
| `rb_size` / `rb_capacity` | Query current/full size |
| `rb_clear` | Resets head/tail/filled to 0 |

All read/write paths handle wrap-around by splitting into at most two contiguous `memcpy`s. Every function guards against NULL inputs as required by the spec and header comments.
